title: Ultimate View, Two Master Suites, Location
description:
TWO SEPARATE BEDROOM SUITES - EACH WITH ITS OWN EN-SUITE BATH.

Available for a six-month lease.

Extraordinary Green Hills hilltop condominium.  Panoramic 10 mile views from every room.  - Elegantly and Luxuriously furnished as shown with a spacious flowing floor plan. 

Amenities include all new high-end bedding, towels, kitchen utensils, dinnerware and even crystal bar service.  Just bring your toothbrush! 

Where indoor & out are seamlessly intertwined.

The space
Elegantly and Luxuriously furnished as shown with a spacious flowing floor plan.  -  Windows and walls have been created to reflect warmth, elegance and sophistication, where indoor and outdoor are seamlessly, elegantly intertwined. 

Large slate patio with panoramic views from downtown Nashville, the airport, and far, far beyond is perfect for an outdoor office, lounging or entertaining, with fire pit and automatic lighting. - 

Includes use of the pool, tennis courts, and private hiking trails. Less than half a mile down the hill is the Bluebird Café, Whole Foods, Nordstrom, Tiffany and the most exclusive shops and restaurants. Ample parking just steps from front door.

* Housekeeping service available.

Guest access
Totally private – guests will enjoy access to the entire condominium and grounds, including the pool, tennis court and private hiking trails.
